captions.detailed: A service-panel three-branch bracket featuring a large, flat, rectangular black backplate. Attached to this base is a thick vertical spine supporting three separate, grey branch pods positioned at different heights and angles. Each branch terminates in a compact, light-grey rectangular end plate. The three branch pods are connected to the main spine via independent revolute joints, allowing each mounting plate to rotate separately with no shared drive mechanism.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a service-panel three-branch bracket. It should feature a large, dark rectangular backplate, a vertical support spine, and three separate branch arms extending outwards. Each arm must terminate in a small rectangular mounting plate and connect to the spine via an independent revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct a flat backplate and a vertical central column as the base assembly. Model three distinct branch arms, each consisting of a small rectangular end plate, an extension bar, and a hinge bracket. Define three independent revolute joints (articulations) to connect each branch arm separately to the central column at different vertical offsets and angular orientations.
